title: Strict Roos model and canonical data
statement: For normalized completion reindexing D and a completed tensor reindexing T satisfying the forward generator law, Model holds if and only if the canonical completed tensor equation holds on every pair of actual localized flat-term K-flat representatives whose localized objects are complete constructible. The canonical equation is restricted to these representatives; no naturality of the independently supplied T.tensor is assumed and no global Canonical equation is inferred.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; strict Roos realization before Canonical.

proof.text: Use CompleteUnit, together with the equivalence between intrinsic and legacy completeness, to show that the specified ordinary-to-completed comparison is an isomorphism on each complete constructible input. Its tensor is therefore an isomorphism.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; strict Roos realization before Canonical.

proof.text: For each P,Q apply the single-representative strict Roos square to T.tower P Q and the supplied generator equation. In the forward direction substitute Model and cancel the representative comparisons. In the reverse direction substitute the canonical equation, cancel the tensor of the two completion isomorphisms, then cancel the inverse representative comparison. Convert between homogeneous equality and HEq. Quantifying these two implications gives the claimed equivalence.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; strict Roos realization before Canonical.

proof_origin.place: CompleteUnit followed by cancellation of completion and representative isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorRoosNormalization_model_iff_canonical
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hgen : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Generators l E g D T) :
    PodCompletedTensorReindex.Model l E g D T ↔
      ∀ (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
        (hP : sfIntegralConstructible l E Y (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))
        (hQ : sfIntegralConstructible l E Y (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj)),
        (podOrdinaryToCompleted l E g D).app
            ((integralCompletedTensor l E Y).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj)) ≫
            ((canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E g ⟨_,hP⟩ ⟨_,hQ⟩).hom).hom =
          (T.tensor ⟨_,hP⟩ ⟨_,hQ⟩).hom ≫
            (integralCompletedTensor l E X).map
              (Prod.mkHom
                ((podOrdinaryToCompleted l E g D).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))
                ((podOrdinaryToCompleted l E g D).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj)))
